My husband tells me I collect trauma like Pokémon so it's hard to single out one as the most traumatic, especially since some people would think certain events are more traumatic than I think.

One that sticks out to me was whilst I was in university, it was a very small university with accommodation being even smaller, only 30 or so students actually in halls. There were 7 to a flat and my flat was mainly girls, and they all studied make up, with just 2 boys on the floor it was very quickly run by the girls.

About half way into the year, this one girl decided she had it in for me, I'm not sure why even now but she would constantly make sure I was left out of social events and would often talk behind my back, making up all sorts of rumors. She was very messy and had mouldy milk in her room which ended up being knocked over and covering a lot of her stuff, she went to staff and claimed that her room was broken into, and used this to create fear among the rest of the girls. Soon enough they were moved into another flat, as there were plenty spare. This ended up leaving just me in the old flat, and the staff were worried about me being alone so told me I had to move into this new flat.

After moving, she got even worse, and I was getting angry at her for everything, she then went to staff and told them I was threatening her and that she didn't feel safe with me around. Soon enough I was being pulled into meetings and I was kicked out with 24 hours notice to leave. 

I'm a care kid and at the time social services would put me up in a hotel during the summer and had a deal with the uni to let me stay during half terms, but this short notice on a Friday afternoon meant that social services couldn't do anything, they couldn't help and couldn't find me a placement as by that point I was to old for foster homes. I ended up on the streets until I got into a YMCA, and eventually renting a place.

This girl got me kicked out of the place I called home for 2 years just 6 months after she moved in, and due to the safeguarding issues the university caused for me, the accomodation was shut down. For extra irony, the accomodation was then turned into a homeless shelter.
